stops.segment: The Refusal, and the Method Exported

stops.date_confidence: attested; the federal War Department rejected the proposed Brooklyn-Battery Bridge on 17 July 1939 on navigation and national-defence grounds, after opposition from preservationists including George McAneny and Albert Bard. stops.stop: Robert Moses Playground, Manhattan, the park that carries the name
stops.date_confidence: attested; the naming resolution was introduced in the City Council in August 1981, weeks after Moses's death, Mayor Ed Koch signed the bill on 27 January 1982, and the park was dedicated on 28 March 1982 with a roller-skate parade setting off from Moses's former residence at 20 East 46th Street.
